text:
claire-marketing: hey @ali-runtime quick request for the launch press kit — need defensible numbers for embed + rerank that we can cite in the one-pager and webinar.

claire-marketing: TL;DR: small reproducible sweep (150-220 samples), compare fp32 vs int8, provide p50/p90/p99/p999 + token/sec, and include 2 slide-ready prompt+rerank examples (one preserved-order, one edge-case). warmup traces required.

claire-marketing: payload mix: 60% short (<128 tokens), 30% medium (300-800), 10% long (2k-6k). include ~10 interactive requests to show KV cache effect.

ali-runtime: got you. Which model variants? and do you want NDCG scoring or just order-check for the slide examples?

claire-marketing: prefer rwin-open-7b-fp32, rwin-open-7b-int8, rwin-open-13b-4bit if capacity allows. For slides: ndcg@10 would be nice but if infra constrained just include order-preservation flags + human-readable diff for the two examples.

sam-devex: tagging: campaign=press-kit, channel=webinar, slide_tag=hero-embed. Please add span annotation warmup=true/false and sample_id so analytics can join the traces.

zack-eng: timeline check  we can run a smoke tonight (short sweep) and a full run tomorrow afternoon. Smoke will include p50/p90/p99 and the two slide examples per variant. Full run will add p999, kernel timings, device metrics.

claire-marketing: smoke by tomorrow 08:30 PT would be ideal so design can lock hero images. final artifacts by EOD tomorrow. priority = high for launch.

bench-bot: Job queued  id=77222, queue=staging-bench, cohort=180, variants=[rwin-open-7b-fp32,rwin-open-7b-int8,rwin-open-13b-4bit], longpct=10. ETA smoke: 2025-01-09T15:30Z.

ali-runtime: reproducible command we'll run:
```
run_bench --cohort presskit_payloads_v1.json \
          --models rwin-open-7b-fp32 rwin-open-7b-int8 rwin-open-13b-4bit \
          --warmup 30 --samples 180 --concurrency 6 \
          --trace-tags "campaign=press-kit,channel=webinar,slide_tag=hero-embed" \
          --scoring ndcg@10 --output artifacts/2619876543-presskit-sweep.tar.gz
```

ali-runtime: we'll capture per-request latencies (p50/p90/p99/p999), token throughput, kernel timings, device util, and a small set of prompt/response pairs for slides. Full logs kept internal; artifacts scrubbed for PII. README will list runtime git sha, model shas, instance SKU, and metric ids.

zack-eng: if int8 shows >12% p99 regression vs fp32 we'll collect kernel profiles and ping infra; we'll also include a short note in README about any observed regressions.

sam-devex: please include metric ids (latency_metric_id, ndcg_metric_id) and a mapping of sample_id -> slide_example_filename in the README so analytics/design can pull images quickly.

claire-marketing: if full sweep doesn't finish by EOD, ship the smoke artifact + one quantized artifact so we can still update the press copy.

bench-bot: Job 77222 started on staging-node-17 at 2025-01-09T15:28:09Z.

ali-runtime: will post smoke report here when available and upload artifacts to https://files.redwood.local/presskit/artifacts/2619876543. ping in thread if anything blocks. :white_check_mark:
